basic_info.description: This Inner Richmond District Duplex features two full-floor flats, each with similar layouts including a formal living room with fireplace and front facing windows, formal dining rooms with hardwood period details (hardwood wall panels and trim) & built-ins, two bedrooms, 1 full plus ½ bath with hardwood floors and inlay trim in the hallways, LR, DR and BR. A rear deck overlooks a westward facing spacious backyard. A partially finished basement offers ADU potential. Located near the Golden Gate Park 10th Ave entrance, de Young Museum and California Academy of Sciences. The lower unit #781 is vacant, while the upper unit #779 is tenant occupied.
